bugs.title: Offline banner never appears on web when the network drops
bugs.evidence: shop-info-offline-savefail: page.context().setOffline(true) -> navigator.onLine === false, but [data-testid=network-status-offline] never shows up (waited 30-45s; reproduced 3 runs). NetworkStatus.tsx only goes offline when NetInfo reports isConnected === false, and on web NetInfo does not report that here. Backend health check returned 200, so the backend is fine.

bugs.title: Pressing PLAY while offline (web dev) throws an uncaught 'Failed to fetch' error and the run never starts
bugs.evidence: After going offline, clicking play-button never reached phase 'running' (waitForFunction timed out after 60s). The error overlay shows 'Uncaught Error: Failed to fetch' at JsiSkDataFactory.fromURI -> loadData, i.e. Skia loads images over the network and the failure is not caught. Console: ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED x39, pageerror Failed to fetch x10. This may only affect the web dev server (native builds bundle their assets), but the unhandled error should fall back gracefully.

action_items.detail: The onboarding differs from the acceptance matrix. The build's steps are welcome+language -> age -> terms (one Accept button, no checkbox, so nothing for Continue to be disabled by) -> name -> how-to -> gift. There is no Permissions step and no skippable Intro. Everything else (7 languages, a single gift of 2,000/50/x3 that is not re-offered after reload or tutorial replay) passed.
Hindi menu translation works (PLAY shows as 'खेलें'). Settings labels stay in English, which matches the partial-translation spec deviation.

Older Phase 1 checks (launch-run-crash-bank, pause-confirm-back, corrupt-save-toggles) expect to land on the main menu from a fresh install. With Phase 2 onboarding that is no longer true, so they are stale and were not re-run. The Phase 1 pause/restart/game-over/play-again flow is now covered by layouts-no-dead-ends.
Backend lane: the game saves locally on the device. No acceptance criterion depends on an API, so only the /api/health test was run.
